narrative.details:
A glint of light on the ground catches your eye from underneath the rubble. Brushing away debris and ash caked onto the object reveals the insignia of a gold anchor on white enameled on the surface: the sign of Theramore.

Underneath the anchor is embossed the name "Lieutenant Paval Reethe".
narrative.objectives: Bring Reethe's Badge to Captain Garran Vimes in Theramore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
It's never good news when a guard's badge is brought to me.

Sometimes it's a man or woman who's fallen in battle, and I'm left to bring the news to the grieving family. Other times we never find out what happened to them. And other times it's even worse than that.
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you found anything of interest at the Shady Rest Inn?
